## Featured research

### Cooperative secure UAV-ISAC

Cooperative UAVs dynamically switch between ISAC transmission and friendly-jamming roles. The project combines role allocation, beamforming, and trajectory optimization to improve physical-layer security while meeting sensing requirements.

### RIS-assisted NOMA

Optimization and performance analysis for downlink NOMA systems assisted by reconfigurable intelligent surfaces under D2D interference.

### UAV-assisted IoT and edge computing

Joint trajectory, task-partitioning, and bit-allocation design for aerial networks supporting IoT and mobile edge computing.

### AI for wireless and medical systems

Deep learning applications spanning V2X fog computing, compressed sensing, and wireless capsule endoscopy image analysis.
